high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram Explore page featuring a post by the account "mafia_minds." The post highlights Rachana Ranade, who is described as a lecturer by profession and a social-media sensation. The text explains that she uploaded a video titled "Basics of Stock Market" on YouTube in 2019 when some of her students were unable to attend a class. This video went viral and significantly changed her life for the better. It mentions that while it was not her first video, it opened up avenues for recognition.
